summary:
[Goal] In the reports folder: any file whose text contains the word DRAFT is obsolete - delete it. Every other report is final: give it the same name with "-final" inserted before the ".md" (copy the content over to the new name, then delete the original). Do not change any content.
[Done] Deleted reports/alpha.md and reports/gamma.md (both contained "DRAFT"). Copied content of reports/beta.md to reports/beta-final.md and deleted reports/beta.md.
[State] The reports/ folder now contains only reports/beta-final.md.
[Key values] reports/beta-final.md
[Decisions] Treated files containing the literal word "DRAFT" as obsolete; treated all other reports as final.
[User] The user is managing report files in a reports/ folder and expects strict content preservation when renaming final reports.
